channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A roadmap for version 1.2 was created and backup documentation was updated to describe a new tiered storage model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An outdated AI submodule was removed and the documentation cleaned up; backup and storage systems in the blockchain network were upgraded to track gaps and retain markers. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor tools got new lockout scenarios, a cash chart, script fixes, and refactored formulas; the SDK introduced a payout address function and improved runner handling; a new numeric input component was added to the client scaffold. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: A milestone audit was completed and related documents were archived; the wallet gained better earnings tracking and API updates; payout address retrieval was added to accounts and a key for request idempotency was introduced. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: New service registration and rotating security tokens were added, password security was tightened, and the user interface received a numeric input component; the build process was forced to use self‑hosted runners and documentation was updated. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: Password handling was improved by fixing hashing and adding tests. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
